title: GraphQL Query Builder
description: Build a GraphQL query from an indented field tree — operation name, nesting and arguments supported.
howto: Type fields one per line, indenting with 2 spaces per level.
Set the operation type and name.
Copy the query or download it as .graphql.

faqs.a: Indent child fields with 2 spaces per level — the builder turns indentation into nested braces.
Write them inline: user(id: "1", active: true) — everything in parentheses is kept verbatim.
Yes — declare them in the signature field, e.g. ($id: ID!), and reference $id in your field arguments.
query, mutation and subscription, each with an optional operation name.
